name: Word Counter & Text Analyzer
shortDescription: Instant word, character, sentence, and reading duration statistics in real-time.
privacyNotice: 100% Client-Side. Your text is processed strictly in your local browser memory and never transmitted over the network.

howToUse.text: Paste your article, essay, or snippet into the main text box above.
Metrics like words, characters with/without spaces, and reading speed calculate in real-time as you type.
Use the Copy button to take your edited copy, or Clear to start fresh.

features: Real-time word, character, and sentence count
Estimated silent reading duration (200 wpm standard)
Zero network requests for total privacy
limitations: Supports browser-supported Unicode and UTF-8 characters
Very large texts (>10 MB) might briefly freeze slower mobile devices

faqs.q: Does ToolXDev store or read my text?
faqs.a: No. The word counting algorithm runs entirely inside your browser using JavaScript. No text is ever uploaded or saved.

faqs.q: Can I use this tool offline?
faqs.a: Yes. Once the page is loaded, you can disconnect your internet and continue analyzing text without interruption.

seoTitle: Free Online Word Counter & Character Analyzer — ToolXDev
seoDescription: Accurate, real-time word counter and character calculator. Free, offline-capable, and 100% private with no server uploads.
